package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for application_lifecycle_missing_shutdown_owner: Shared resources with visible startup paths but no obvious shutdown owner or lifecycle wrapper.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
func main() {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/health", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		fmt.Fprintln(w, "healthy")
	})

	db := openDB("postgres://localhost:5432/mydb")
	defer db.Close()

	cache := connectRedis("localhost:6379")
	defer cache.Close()

	server := &http.Server{
		Addr:    ":8080",
		Handler: mux,
	}

	log.Printf("starting server on %s", server.Addr)
	if err := server.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
		log.Fatalf("server error: %v", err)
	}
}

func openDB(dsn string) *fakeDB { return &fakeDB{} }
func connectRedis(addr string) *fakeRedis { return &fakeRedis{} }

type fakeDB struct{}
func (f *fakeDB) Close() error { return nil }

type fakeRedis struct{}
func (f *fakeRedis) Close() error { return nil }
